coordinator.eligible_role: Coordinator, assuming access to requirements, decisions, capability responses, and returned artifacts.
coordinator.generator_role: Conditional only: its own generation skill must be available and read, its own usable execution path must be verified, and it must satisfy any vision or inspection requirements imposed by that skill/task.
coordinator.generation_question: May own the question only when qualified as generation executor, or relay a concrete question from another verified generation owner. Skill ownership alone is insufficient when execution path is unknown.
coordinator.visual_roles: Not established by the case; require this coordinator's own verified vision for the relevant images.
coordinator.evidence_boundary: Must attribute reviewer's visual findings; cannot claim it saw images solely because the reviewer did.

eligible_roles: Structural/code worker if it has an approved readable plan or structured/measured handoff and verified access to its assigned source files.
Unity operator/capture worker only if its access to the intended Editor and necessary tools is separately verified; returns technical evidence and screenshots for another owner to review.
excluded_roles: Image generator: no own generation skill.
child.reason: A standalone image tool does not satisfy the generation-skill prerequisite; the parent's skill plus the child's tool does not qualify the child. No vision also precludes independent raster analysis or visual quality claims.
child.allowed_work: Only authorized structured or technical work supported by verified capabilities; preserve explicit gaps and provisional status.
forbidden_fallbacks: Do not install a skill automatically.
Do not call an alternate image API/provider to bypass qualification.
Do not infer image contents or visual PASS.
Do not treat user generation approval as a waiver of the skill prerequisite.

eligible_roles: Visual analyst / asset reviewer for exact accessible input and candidate revisions.
Visual QA reviewer for exact final images and source design at required display sizes.
separate_reviewer.conditions: The reviewer must actually receive and interpret the relevant artifacts; a generic claim of vision is not enough.
separate_reviewer.generator_role: Not established; would separately need its own available/read generation skill and usable path.
separate_reviewer.user_approval_boundary: Visual review or technical PASS does not grant user art acceptance.
